name: Dreamy Duskywing
desc: Dreamy Duskywing (Erynnis icelus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Erynnis icelus, also known as the dreamy duskywing or aspen dusky wing, is a species of butterfly in the family Hesperiidae. It is found in boreal North America.
